# Purpose of this notebook
The queries in this notebook identify *potential* opportunities for cost savings by discovering hosts that are running in Fullstack mode but, at least at the moment, have no instrumented services running on them.

Further analysis should be done on these host to make sure that they truly do not need to be in Fullstack mode.

input.value:
// Get the list of hosts in "FULL_STACK" mode that don't have any services running on them
fetch dt.entity.host
| filter monitoringMode == "FULL_STACK"
| expand service = runs[dt.entity.service]
| filter isNull(service)

// Figure out the raw memory and DPS-counted memory
| fields MemoryInGiB = toDouble(memoryTotal) / 1024 / 1024 / 1024
| fieldsAdd RoundedMemory = if (MemoryInGiB >= 4.00, ceil(MemoryInGiB * 4) / 4, else:4.00)

// Summarize to get the totals
| summarize `Host Count` = count(), `Total Memory` = sum(MemoryInGiB), `Fullstack Gibibytes Allocated`=sum(RoundedMemory)

// Do the math for an entire year
| fieldsAdd `Gibibyte-Hours per Year` = `Fullstack Gibibytes Allocated` * 24 * 365
| fieldsAdd `Fullstack Annual Cost` = `Gibibyte-Hours per Year` * 478 / 100000
| fieldsAdd `Infrastructure Annual Cost` = toDouble(`Host Count` * 24 * 365 * 1912 / 100000)
| fieldsAdd `Potential Savings` = `Fullstack Annual Cost` - `Infrastructure Annual Cost`

categoricalBarChartSettings.valueAxisLabel: MemoryGB,DPS Memory,Gibibyte-Hours per Year,Fullstack Annual Cost,Infrastructure Annual Cost,Potential Savings
